EDHM_2DMigoto (optional tailored 2DMigoto runtime for EDHM)
===========================================================

ED-UP optionally ships a pinned, signed copy of d3d11_edhm.dll from
EDHM_2DMigoto (https://github.com/Fenris159/EDHM_2DMigoto), opt-in only.
When enabled, ED-UP places d3d11_edhm.dll together with the full GPLv3
license text (EDHM-2DMIGOTO-LICENSE.txt) and bundled third-party notices
(EDHM-2DMIGOTO-THIRD-PARTY.txt) beside the game, and backs up your
existing standard d3d11_edhm.dll for restoration when turned off.

Project lineage:
  - EDHM_2DMigoto: https://github.com/Fenris159/EDHM_2DMigoto (GNU GPLv3)
  - XXMI-Libs-Package: https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Libs-Package (GNU GPLv3)
  - 3Dmigoto: https://github.com/bo3b/3Dmigoto (GNU GPLv3)
  - Deviare-InProcess / Nektra: https://github.com/nektra (GNU GPLv3)

Bundled third-party components inside d3d11_edhm.dll:
  - PCRE2 10.30 (BSD 3-clause license with binary exemption;
    https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/tag/pcre2-10.30)
  - DirectXTK (MIT License; Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation;
    https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXTK)
  - crc32c-hw 1.0.5 (zlib-style license)

EDHM (Elite Dangerous HUD Mod):
  - EDHM is a separate community project (https://github.com/psychicEgg/EDHM).
    ED-UP does not bundle EDHM themes or shaders; this optional runtime only
    replaces the 3Dmigoto d3d11_edhm.dll loader in an existing EDHM install
    when opted in.

Corresponding Source offer (GNU GPLv3 Section 6):
  - Pinned release: v0.1.8 (commit 2cbeaa381c57f4848144d3a1510ed34f8f41f0e5)
  - Source tree:    https://github.com/Fenris159/EDHM_2DMigoto/tree/2cbeaa381c57f4848144d3a1510ed34f8f41f0e5
  - Source archive: https://github.com/Fenris159/EDHM_2DMigoto/archive/2cbeaa381c57f4848144d3a1510ed34f8f41f0e5.tar.gz
  - Archive SHA256: 17bfffe33ff43439a72e003c87c530dfcf07aa4c19950fa3e8d027a57a4e1401
  - Binary SHA256:  3480813a4ecffce90c7b29e57b62788ea0b1a6aff5be06120cdf237fea054eb4
  - Build steps:    Extract the pinned source archive on Windows with Visual Studio 2022
                    (Desktop development with C++, Windows 10/11 SDK) and build the
                    "Zip Release | x64" configuration via MSBuild as documented in
                    .github/workflows/release.yml inside the pinned commit.

The complete text of GNU General Public License v3.0 follows below (and is
also shipped beside the game as EDHM-2DMIGOTO-LICENSE.txt together with
EDHM-2DMIGOTO-THIRD-PARTY.txt whenever the optional runtime is installed).
